The spores, the fresh plant. This species is found all over the world and occurs throughout Great Britain, being most plentiful on the moors of the northern counties. Though this species of Club Moss occurs in Great Britain, the spores are collected chiefly in Russia, Germany and Switzerland, in July and August, the tops of the plants being cut as the spikes approach maturity and the powder shaken out and separated by a sieve. Probably the spores used commercially are derived also from other species in addition to Lycopodium clavatum .

Crawling scraping in trachea, at night. Hoarseness, with roughness, and pain as from excoriation in chest, after speaking. (Voice feeble and husky.). Cough excited by a tickling, or as if produced by the vapour of sulphur, or by taking a deep inspiration, generally with a yellowish grey and saltish expectoration, sometimes with great weakness of stomach, fever, nocturnal sweat, and emaciation. Cough with expectoration through the day and without expectoration during the night. Whooping-cough from irritation in trachea as from fumes of sulphur, in the morning and during the day, with expectoration of fetid pus or of mucus streaked with blood. Cough from 4 to 6 p.m., frequently on alternate days, from exertion, from stretching the arms out, stooping and lying down, when lying on l. side, from eating and drinking cold things, in the wind, or in warm room. Cough (morning), with copious expectoration of greenish matter. Copious expectoration of pus, when coughing. Cough, with expectoration of blood. When coughing, shocks in the head, shortness of breath, smarting and concussion in chest, or pains in region of stomach. Tearings and shootings in the joints of shoulder and elbow. Rheumatic tension in r. shoulder-joint. Pain in bones of arms at night. Weakness of arms when at work. Difficulty in moving arms as if rheumatism were creeping on, with nodes on fingers. Great desire for, or marked repugnance to fresh air, with excessive sensitiveness to cool air. Great tendency to take cold. From east winds.

Sense of smell very acute. Feeling of dryness posteriorly. Scanty excoriating, discharge anteriorly. Ulcerated nostrils. Crusts and elastic plugs (Kal b; Teuc). Fluent coryza. Nose stopped up. Snuffles; child starts from sleep rubbing nose. Fan-like motion of aloe nasi (Kali brom; Phos)

Scurf in nose; crusts and elastic plugs. Nostrils ulcerated, scabby, obstructed by mucus at night. Swelling of nose, with acrid, fetid, and corrosive discharge. The ichorous discharge from the nose begins in r. nostril; scarlatina or diphtheria. (Patient bores and picks nose. Convulsive movements of muscles of nose. Fan-like motion of the nostrils in pneumonia. Bleeding from nose, on blowing it, and epistaxis, principally in afternoon. (Nose-bleed in morning from r. nostril.). Excessive acuteness of smell. Coryza with acrid discharge, making the upper lips sore. Coryza of almost all kinds. Dry coryza, with obstruction of the nose, confusion in head, and burning pain in forehead. Dryness of the posterior nares. Obstruction of nostrils, esp. at night, and which prevents respiration except through the mouth. Stoppage: towards morning; in evening; child's breath often stopped in sleep for fifteen seconds even when mouth is open.

Oversensitiveness of smell. Frequent epistaxis ; principally in afternoon. Dryness and stoppage of nose. Stopped catarrh, cannot get breath at night. Nose stopped up, especially at root ; breathes with open mouth and protruding tongue. θ Diphtheria. Stoppage of nose, with dryness of posterior nares, fetid secretion, hoarseness, rawness, and soreness of chest ; nightly tickling cough, with sensation as from sulphur-vapor in throat. Snuffles, child starts out of sleep rubbing its nose. Fluent coryza, with redness of eyes and lachrymation, frequent flushes of heat and yawning. Violent coryza, nose swollen ; discharge acrid ; excoriating ; posterior nares dry. Long lasting coryza, discharge purulent. Violent catarrh, with swelling of nose. Catarrh, with acrid discharge from nose, makes upper lip sore. Ichorous discharge from nose, begins in right nostril. θ Scarlatina. θ Diphtheria. Catarrh of nose and frontal sinuses ; discharge yellow and thick ; frontal headache ; yellow complexion. Thick yellow discharge, copious and fatty ; constipation ; prostration ; impotence ; palpitation. θ Nasal catarrh. Scurf or crusts in nose ; nightly closure of nasal openings in dry coryza. Discharge of elastic plugs from nose. θ Catarrh. Very sensitive smell ; violent coryza, acrid and making upper lip sore ; posterior nares feel dry, and nostril is closed every morning with what looks like inspissated pus. θ Polypus. Fanlike motion of alæ nasi. θ Pneumonia. Pimples sore and acrid on end of nose. Child wakes at night and rubs nose so much and long that parents are frightened ; it won't stop rubbing its nose. θ Catarrh of breast.

stomach.text: STOMACH. ► Appetite. ► *Appetite increased (thirteenth day), [31] . ►► *Great appetite , [19] . ► *Very great appetite (after second day), [17] ; (third day), [19a] . ►► *Excessive appetite, followed by distension of the abdomen (thirty-third day), [34c] . ► *Hunger (twenty-first and twenty-third days), [34d] ; at 10 A.M., [10b] , etc. [1010.] ► Hunger on waking at night, [1] . ►► *Hunger remains immediately after eating, though the stomach and abdomen are full and tense , [1] . ► Great hunger during a walk (fifteenth day), [34d] . ► Great hunger and hasty eating, [1] . ► Excessive hunger; the more he eats the more the stomach desires; and so long as he eats he feels well, but afterwards there is a constant sourish taste on the tongue, even the saliva seems acid; nothing of which, however, he noticed while eating, [1] . ► Ravenous hunger at noon, while eating; with a feeling as though he could not satisfy himself, [1] . ► Constant ravenous hunger, in the afternoon; with a feeling as if heavy morsels were lying in the stomach, [1] . ► Desire to eat without real hunger, [1] . ► Remarkable desire to smoke (eighth day), [30] . ► *Appetite diminished (sixth day), [27] ; (twenty-second day), [31] ; (twenty-fifth day), [29] . [1020.] ► *Loss of appetite (second day), [15] ; (after three days), [1] ; etc. ► Loss of appetite, but much thirst (after thirty days), [1] . ► Loss of appetite (has had no desire for tobacco for eight days), (twenty-fourth day), [30] . ► Complete loss of appetite (thirty-ninth day), [31] . ► Complete loss of appetite and thirst (sixth day), [28] . ► No appetite (ninth day), [30] ; (eleventh day), [33] . ► Food is not relished; he has not the slightest appetite, [1] . ► Neither appetite nor thirst (fifth day), [26] . ►► *She cannot eat at all; is constantly satiated and without appetite, and whatever she eats goes against her, even to vomiting , [1] . ► *After eating a little roast lamb, a feeling of heaviness in the stomach, tension in the abdomen , sudden satiety, and great thirst , at noon (fifth day), [29] . [1030.] ► Aversion to all food (twelfth day), [29] . ► Aversion to all and food and even coffee, in the morning (seventeenth day), [29] . ► Almost disgusted with eating, [1] . ► The best food at times disgusts him for a moment before he tastes it, but afterwards he cannot eat enough, [1] . ► Aversion to solid food, especially meat; with thirst (first day), [1] . ► Aversion to breakfast (ninth and eighteenth days), [30] . ► Aversion to eating much supper (seventeenth day), [30] . ► Aversion to bread, he prefers warm food, [1] . ► *Aversion to coffee and tobacco , [1] . ► *No desire for the morning coffee (thirteenth day), [29] . ► Thirst. [1040.] ► Thirst with increased heat of the head, at 3 P.M. (twenty-seventh day), [30] . ► Thirst at night; she is obliged to drink frequently, though but little at a time (after sixteen days), [1] . ► *Constant thirst, with dry lips and dry mouth ; yet if she takes a little swallow it nauseates her, and she cannot swallow it; therewith she is sick, weak, and weary, [1] . ► Much thirst (third day), [28] ; after eating, [1] . ► Much thirst; she constantly desires to drink, [7] . ► Great thirst and heat of the head, with sleepiness, so that he could not keep awake, at 8 P.M. (eighth day), [30] . ► Excessive thirst, with fine frothy saliva in the mouth (after one hour), [1] . ► Burning thirst, which I quenched with water all day; I ascribed this thirst to a slimy, sour, bitter expectoration, the taste of which I could not get rid of two days (second day), [15] . ► Great desire for drink (seventh day), [26] . ► No thirst; thirstlessness , [1] . ► Eructation and Hiccough. [1050.] ► *Eructations (ninth day), [29] . ► Eructations without taste, at times (second day), [17a] . ► Frequent odorless and tasteless eructations, with pressure in the stomach, retching and pressure in the throat (second day), [9i] . ► Eructations tasting of the food (first day), [1] . ► Eructations without bad taste, after eating, [9] . ► Frequent eructations, after eating, [1] . ► Many eructations , alternating with yawning, [1] . ► Empty eructations all day (sixteenth day), [1] ; half an hour after dinner (fourteenth day), [30] . ► Frequent empty eructations (first days), [1] . ► Eructations, risings of salty mucus, [9a] . [1060.] ► Sour eructations after every meal, with risings of digested food, [1] . ► Sour eructations, with burning in the pharynx, after dinner (fifth day), [9c] . ► Sour eructations, with colic (immediately), [1] . ► *A sour eructation, the taste of which does not remain in the mouth, but the acid gnaws in the stomach , [1] . ► Many sourish eructations, [1] . ► *Eructations as from an acid stomach (second day), [9i] . ► *Acid eructations, with a burning sensation as far up as the throat (first day), [9c] . ► Eructations of an acid fluid, with sour taste in the mouth, [1] . ► Constant bilious eructations, in the afternoon, [1] . ► Burning eructation; a kind of heartburn, [1] . [1070.] ►► *Incomplete burning eructations, which only rise into the pharynx, where they cause a burning for several hours (after four hours), [1] . ► Rising from the stomach through the sophagus to the pharynx, where they cause a retching (second day), [28] . ► Sour risings at night, [1] . ► Rising of the milk taken in the morning, with scraping-clawing taste in the throat, [1] . ► Bitter water comes every morning into the mouth, as from the stomach, so that she is obliged to bend out of bed in order to spit it out, as in waterbrash, [1] . ► Waterbrash , almost every other day; griping in the pit of the stomach; nausea; she is obliged to open her mouth, from which much salty water flows, as if it rose from the stomach, [1] . ►► *Hiccough , [2] . ► Hiccough, after every meal (after nineteen days), [1] . ► Hiccough, after supper, lasting half an hour, [1] . ► Frequent hiccough for three days in succession (after four days), [1] . ► Heartburn. [1080.] ► *Heartburn (second day), [9i] ; (twenty-fourth day), [34d] . ► Heartburn for three hours after eating, aggravated by tobacco smoke, [1] . ► Heartburn after eating (cold roast mutton), with a pressure upon the chest as if a stone were lying upon it (after thirty-three days), [1] . ► Heartburn for half an hour after every meal, with acid eructations and burning in the pit of the stomach for several hours, which almost takes away the breath and makes him very weak, [1] . ► Heartburn rising from the stomach, causing acidity in the mouth, [1] . ► Heartburn after smoking (twentieth day), [34d] . ► Heartburn and a qualmish nausea in the stomach, so that he was obliged to lie down, in the morning while smoking as usual (eighth day), [24] . ► Heartburn rising into the chest, followed by acidity in the mouth, [1] . ► Nausea and Vomiting. ► *Nausea, every morning fasting , [1] . ► Nausea in the morning (soon after a dose, thirteenth day), [29] . [1090.] ► Nausea and emptiness of the stomach, in the morning after rising, and especially on walking about the room, as if perspiration would break out, [1] . ► Nausea, in the afternoon, with uprisings of a sourish taste, [1] . ► Nausea, on looking at food; with collection of saliva of a flat, insipid taste, [1] . ► Nausea aggravated by reading; thought was difficult (first day), [9c] . ► Nausea in the room, disappearing on going into the open air ; and again nausea in the open air, disappearing in the room, [1] . ► *Nausea, during menstruation , [1] . ► Nausea and accumulation of water in the mouth, soon after a dose (seventeenth day), [34c] . ► Nausea and inclination to vomit, after smoking (twenty-third day), [34d] . ► Nausea and pain in the stomach, which made her cry, immediately after a dose (eighth day), [31] . ► Nausea, with heat in the abdomen, and icy coldness of the face (after second day), [1] . [1100.] ► Nausea, with oppression of the chest and pit of the stomach, and weakness of the limbs, transiently relieved by empty eructations, then returning with crawling in the throat and pit of the stomach, [2] . ► Nausea, constant yawning and griping in the abdomen (half an hour after a new dose, sixth day), [29] . ► *Nausea in the throat and stomach, even to vomiting, after a meal, with accumulation of water in the mouth , [1] . ► Nausea in the stomach (second day), [29] ; (third and fifth days), [25] ; in morning (tenth and twenty-fifth days), [30] , etc. ► *Nausea in the stomach, and qualmishness before breakfast (twelfth day), [30] . ► Nausea in the stomach, aversion to everything, with a white-coated tongue, and a feeling of rawness upon it, in the morning (nineteenth day), [30] . ► *Nausea in the stomach, with accumulation of water in the mouth and qualmishness, after waking and rising from the bed in the morning, so that she was obliged to sit down (sixth day), [27] . ► Nausea in the stomach like a cramp, with confusion of the head (fifth day), [28] . ► Frequent nausea, and complains of pain in the umbilical and epigastric regions and in the head (fifth day), [28] . ► Frequent attacks of nausea, with trembling of the limbs (especially on smoking), and acceleration of the pulse (fourth day), [24] . [1110.] ► Almost constant nausea (fourth day), [25] . ► Constant nausea (twenty-fifth day), [34c] . ► Nausea constant every evening, [9d] . ► *Constant nausea in the stomach (seventh day), [24] . ► Constant nausea in the stomach, with great sensitiveness of the pit of the stomach (sixth day), [28] . ► Sudden nausea and heat of the face, at 2 P.M. (first day), [31] . ► Great nausea, amounting even to faintness during dinner; sweat on the forehead and complete loss of appetite, [1] . ► Feels several times as if he wanted to be sick, in the night, [41] . ► Qualmishness with tremulous weakness of the body (sixth day), [28] . ► Qualmishness and inclination to vomit, with accumulation of water in the mouth, in the morning (twenty-sixth day), [34c] . [1120.] ► Qualmish sensation in the stomach, as in excessive hunger (a sensation I had frequently experienced when a boy); this sensation disappeared after coffee (after one hour), [17a] . ► Retching, with efforts to vomit; after eating, rising of water, which runs from the mouth (waterbrash), [1] . ► Retching in the throat, with risings of mucus (first day), [9c] . ► Inclination to vomit (eleventh and twelfth days), [34d] ; in morning (tenth day), [30] . ► Inclination to vomit, with hunger (twenty-second day), [43d] . ► Inclination to vomit, without aversion to food, and with good appetite, in the afternoon (first day), [34d] . ► Inclination to vomit, with eructations of gas, in the afternoon (twenty-ninth day), [34d] . ► Inclination to vomit, with retching of frothy foam, [1] . ► The child vomits mucus five times after the midday nap, [1] . ► *Vomiting of food and bile , preceded by nausea and anxiety at the heart, at night (after nine days), [1] . [1130.] ► Vomiting of clotted blood and sharp acid, [1] . ► Stomach. ► Rumbling in the stomach (third day), [16a] . ► Sensations as from a disordered stomach, [1] . ►► *Digestion seems to proceed very slowly , [1] . ► Emptiness in the stomach before dinner, so that he is constantly obliged to yawn, [1] . ► Feeling of emptiness and inclination to vomit; it seems as though the latter would take place from the slightest mechanical assistance (lasting three of four minutes), (second day), [29] . ► A sensation in the stomach after dinner of long fasting, though without hunger, [1] . ► Anxious feeling about the pit of the stomach, as in rapid passive motion, for instance, swinging, [1] . ►► *Discomfort in the stomach after eating a little (thirty-eighth day), [31] . ► *Pain in the stomach (seventh day), [32a] . [1140.] ► *Pain in the stomach, aggravated by sitting bent over , [1] . ► *Pain in stomach and region of duodenum (eighth day), [29] . ► Pain in the stomach and intestines, followed by two greenish pasty stools, in the morning (twenty-fourth day), [29] . ► Pains in the stomach and nausea; constant yawning; heat of the face, an hour after a dose (ninth day), [32a] . ►► *Pain in the epigastric region, caused by coughing , [1] . ► Violent pain in the stomach, after eating or taking a slight cold, with chilliness, so that she could not get warm, and a feeling of deadness of the hands (after twenty-three days), [1] . ► Violent pain above the stomach, so that she could not lace herself, or bear anything tight about her (eighth day), [1] . ► Acute pain in the pit of the stomach, on external pressure, [1] . ► Burning in the stomach, at 9 P.M. (fifth day), [9c] .; in afternoon (twenty-ninth day), [34d] . ► Burning in the stomach and abdomen (sixth day), [28] . [1150.] ► Burning in the stomach, that extended to the sophagus (two hours after a dose, fourth day), [29] . ► Burning beginning at the stomach and extending to the pharynx (ninth day), [29] . ► Burning like fire in the stomach, extending to the pharynx, eructations of food; metallic taste; sensitiveness of the epigastric region, after dinner (tenth day), [29] . ► *Tension in the stomach and hypochondria (tenth day), [29] . ► Sticking tension about the pit of the stomach, on breathing, [2] . ► *Feeling of tension beneath the stomach, as if everything were too tight, with a sore sensation on the chest (twentieth day), [29] . ► *Constriction and cramp in the stomach , extending into the chest, from morning till evening, [1] . ► *Griping in the stomach (thirtieth day), [30] . ► *Cramp in the stomach (first day), [17a] . ► Cramp in the stomach, in the morning on waking, lasting three-quarters of an hour (third day), [1] . [1160.] ►► *Cramp in the stomach, which is much distended , [1] . ► Cramp in the stomach, before eating, with ineffectual eructations, renewed by wine, [3] . ► Violent cramp in the stomach, at midnight (second night), [17] . ► Aching pain in stomach and abdomen (after fifth dose, second day), [39] . ► *Pressure in the stomach (second day), [28] ; (seventh day), [27] . ► *Pressure in the pit of the stomach , [3] ; (first day), [1] . ► Pressure in the pit of the stomach, before dinner, [2] . ► *Pressure in the stomach after a light meal (twenty-fifth day), [31] . ► Pressure in the pit of the stomach, especially in the afternoon and after lifting, with pain in it, even when touched, [1] . ► Pressure in the stomach , appearing in the afternoon while riding in a carriage, soon disappearing, but reappearing at night while lying on the back, with difficult respiration; when lying on the side it disappeared; therewith the stomach was very sensitive to touch and felt swollen (third day), [24] . [1170.] ► Pressure above the stomach, at the cardiac orifice, in the evening, [1] . ► Pressure in the stomach, after every meal, [1] . ► Pressure in the stomach, lasting half an hour after dinner, with eructations and repeated yawning (twenty-eighth day), [31] . ► Pressure in the stomach and heaviness in the abdomen, after a dinner of veal (twenty-third day), [29] . ►► *Pressure at stomach as though she had eaten too much , [35] . ► Pressure in the pit of the stomach and lower portion of the chest, after lifting something heavy, [1] . ► Pressure in the pit of the stomach, and choking in the pharynx, that compels frequent empty swallowing (third day), [28] . ► *Pressure in the stomach, with difficult breathing (third day), [28] . ► Pressure in the stomach, and difficult breathing, while lying on the back at night, disappearing while lying on the side (second night), [28] . ►► *Pressure in the stomach as if overdistended, in the evening after eating a little (fifth day), [9c] . [1180.] ► Pressure and a feeling of fulness in the stomach, eructations of food and colic after a very moderate meal (seventh day), [29] . ► *Pressure, heaviness in the stomach, after eating a little in the afternoon (second day), [9i] . ► Constant pressure in the stomach, with tension in the abdomen, [1] . ► Violent pressure and constriction in the stomach, like that associated with nausea (after five minutes), [19] . ► Violent pressure in the stomach and abdomen, the whole forenoon, with pain on touch and on breathing, [1] . ► Distressing pressure in the stomach, in the evening in bed , relieved by rubbing (first days), [1] . ► Heaviness in the stomach, two hours after breakfast, [1] . ► Twisting in the pit of the stomach, with flushes of dry heat in the face, [4] . ► During vexation, a sudden shooting in the pit of the stomach, followed by a leaden heaviness of the limbs, [1] . ► Cutting in the epigastric region, at night; she is obliged to rise, [1] . [1190.] ► Tearing and drawing pain in the stomach, with nausea and pain in the abdomen, as from a needle thrust into the intestines, [1] . ► *Stomach sensitive to pressure (seventeenth day), [34c] . ► *Unusual sensitiveness of the epigastric region (sixth day), [28] . ► *Epigastric region extremely sensitive to every touch (third day), [28] . ► Bruised pain in the stomach, disappearing after eructations; the stomach is very painful to pressure, [1] . ► Gnawing and clawing in the stomach and feeling as if full, [1] . ► Throbbing in the pit of the stomach, on straightening the upper part of the body, [1] . ► Pulsation in the pit of the stomach (seventeenth day), [34c] . ► Pricking at times at cardiac end of stomach, in a spot which is tender to touch (third day), [38] . >>>>> Copyright © Médi-T ® 2000 Lyc.

rectum.text: STOOL. ► Diarrha. ► Diarrha (fifteenth day), [30] ; in morning (seventeenth day), [24] . ► Diarrha, with colic, mostly very early in morning (about 2 or 3 o'clock), [1] . ► Diarrha six times, with violent griping, from morning till noon; three times in the afternoon (thirty-second day), [30] . ► Diarrha three times, consisting of green, extremely offensive fæces (fourth day), [29] . ► Three attacks of diarrha, with pain in the abdomen, in the afternoon (sixteenth day), [30] . ► Diarrha, with griping and tenesmus, three times, from 12 to 3 o'clock (twenty-fourth day), [30] . [1500.] ► Diarrha twice in the forenoon, preceded by griping (nineteenth day), [31] . ► Urging to stool in the morning; diarrha in the afternoon, [1] . ► Frequent diarrha (fourth and fifth days), [33] . ► Watery diarrha twice (sixth day); soft, watery stools, with burning in the anus (seventh day); diarrha (eighth day), [28] . ► Yellow, watery diarrha six times during the day (fourth day), [26] . ► Yellowish-white diarrha four or five times, with increase of the pain in the walls of the abdomen, so that even laughing was painful (thirteenth day), [30] . ► Two diarrhic stools in the forenoon (twenty-sixth day), [31] . ► Stool very frequent, consisting of blood and mucus, with peculiar offensive "earthy" smell; the desire for stool very urgent; bowels act thus directly after drinking and at other times (four days after leaving off Lyc.), [41] . ► Soft stool several times a day, which must be evacuated with much exertion, without emission of flatus, [1] . ► Violent twisting in bowels; continual urgent desire for stool, could hardly retain it; it rushed out first in a large fluid gush, after which the quantity was slight: great bearing down in rectum; pain better after stool; this sort of stool occurred three times (after fourteen days), [43] . [1510.] ► Two liquid stools (third day), [34c] . ► Two green, very offensive evacuations in the morning (fifth day), [29] . ► Two evacuations instead of the usual single stool (first day), [10] . ► Much urging to stool, with discharge of much hard fæces, followed after two hours by pressure in the abdomen, renewed urging to stool, and a soft evacuation (eighth day), [11a] . ► Pasty stool, once or twice a day, for several weeks, [1] . ► Urging to stool an hour after the normal stool, followed by discharge of pasty fæces mixed with mucus (fourteenth day), [1] . ► Pasty evacuation from the bowels, soon followed by renewed urging, with a sensation as though diarrha would come on, but there resulted only a small fecal discharge, firmer than the previous stool (sixth day), [11a] . ► A thin evacuation from the bowels (third day), [27] . ► Thin stool, mixed with hard lumps, [1] . ► (Stool soft, almost like diarrha), [9h] . [1520.] ►► *The first part of the stool is lumpy, the second soft , for several days in succession (after sixteen days), [1] . ► Soft, painful stools (twenty-fifth day), [34d] . ► Stool yellow and pasty (sixth day), [26] . ► Soft, pasty stool, with a feeling of tenesmus and dragging in the rectum, as in dysentery (twenty-third day), [29] . ► Stool of a brown, liver color, [34b] . ► Stool very pale in color, [1] . ► Very offensive stool, [1] . ► Profuse discharge of thin mucus, but the stool was scanty, at noon, [1] . ► Discharge of blood during the stool , [1] . ► Discharge of blood from the rectum, even with a soft stool (after fourteen days), [1] . [1530.] ► Crumbly stool, in small pieces, [1] . ► *Hard stools (after three days), [37] . ► A hard stool, only after great pressure, in the evening (seventh day), [34c] . ► *Stool dry and hard , for three days, more than usually indolent (first day), [9e] . ► Stool at first hard, then liquid (second day), [34c] . ► Urging to stool, with rather hard fæces, in the evening, followed all night by excessive flatulence (fifth day), [16a] . ► *Very hard stool (fifteenth day), [34d] . ► Stool unusually hard (second to fourth day), [17a] . ► The stools, though soft, were difficult to pass; (this condition lasted a long time after the proving), [34d] . ► Very difficult stool, from contraction of the rectum, [1] . ► Constipation. [1540.] ► Stool daily, very small, and only passed with great urging and burning pain in the rectum, [1] . ► Scanty stool, with a feeling as though much remained behind, followed by much painful accumulation of flatus in the abdomen (after twenty-four hours), [1] . ► Stool only every other day, [2] . ► Stool not daily, indolent, without desire, [1] . ► Bowels act with difficulty and pain, [41] . ► Two hard evacuations passed with difficulty and pain in the anus, after which there were none for two days, then another hard stool in the evening, very difficult to pass, with tearing pain in the rectum; two days afterwards another hard stool, with great pressure (after twenty-five days), [34c] . ► Hard stool, difficult to pass (third day), [34d] . ► Hard, scanty, difficult stool (eighth day), [34d] . ► Stool hard, with great pressure and tenesmus, and a peculiar sensation of burning like fire that extended from the anus deep into the rectum (twelfth day), [29] . [The first stool for days, succeeding a diarrha that seemed to be the primary effect of the drug-T. F. A.] ► Stool at 4 P.M. (instead of 8 A.M. as usual); evacuation very hard (third day), [17a] . [1550.] ► No desire for stool in the morning, but in the evening instead; although the desire is quite urgent, the small fæces can hardly be forced out, [2] . ► Stool retained first two or three days, afterwards a natural, copious evacuation, [1] . ► Absence of the usual two morning stools (eleventh day), [29] . ► Constipation from the eighth to the eleventh day, when there was a hard stool, difficult to pass, [34c] .

urinary.text: URINARY ORGANS. ► Bladder. ► Pressive pain in the region of the bladder and in the scrotum (third day), [9i] . ► Stitches in the bladder, [3] . ► Stitches in the neck of the bladder and in the anus at the same time, [1] . ► Urethra. ► Slight, thin yellowish secretion from the urethra, without burning, in the evening (thirtieth day), [29] . ► Discharge of some mucus from the urethra (third day), [20c] . ► Discharge of purulent mucus from the urethra continued, accompanied by burning pain during micturition, for two days; on the third day, a painful sensation on urinating, which had formerly extended into the scrotum, was diminish, and the amount of mucous discharge was less, [20] . [1560.] ► Discharge of prostatic fluid without cause, [1] . ► Discharge of prostatic fluid, without erections, with great lasciviousness, [1] . ► Discharge of blood from the urethra, without pain (after six days), [1] . ► Pain in the urethra, as from a foreign substance, in the morning (second day), [19b] . ► Burning during micturition (first day), [20b] . ► Burning in the urethra while urinating (fifth and seventh days), [32a] . ► Burning along the urethra while urinating at 2 A.M., and lasting a quarter of an hour (second day), [29] . ► Burning along the urethra for two minutes after urinating in the forenoon (twenty-fourth day), [29] . ► Burning in the female urethra while urinating, [1] . ► Burning in the forepart of the urethra while urinating in the evening, [9i] . [1570.] ► Constant burning during micturition, with discharge, at first clear, then purulent, like odorless mucus, which in the afternoon was streaked with blood, [20] . ► Violent burning during micturition, [20] . ► Crawling-burning in the urethra, after urinating, in the evening on going to sleep, [2] . ► (Tension and pain in the prostate and urethra), (second and following day), [19] . [Not a very unusual symptom.] ► Extremely painful constriction, dragging and burning along the urethra, extending into the bladder after urinating (thirtieth day), [30] . ► Violent, though transient, drawing pain in the forepart of the urethra, [2] . ► Jerking-drawing in the back part of the urethra, [2] . ► Disagreeable twinging sensation, as after taking new beer, along the course of the urethra in the morning (fifth day), [29] . ► Transient cutting in the forepart of the urethra, [1] . ► Fine sticking pain in the forepart of the urethra, where it seems to pierce the glans penis, without the slightest pain on urinating (third day), [11b] . [1580.] ► Tearing in the orifice of the urethra for some time after urinating, [2] . ► Smarting during micturition, [3] . ► Smarting in the female urethra, in the evening during micturition, [1] . ► Micturition. ► Desire to urinate for a moment while lying; the urine passed only by drops, and caused a burning like fire; in the evening (fifth day), [24] . ► *Frequent desire to urinate (seventh day), [29] . ► Desire to urinate three times in one night, with scanty discharge (first day), [9a] . ► Desire to urinate four times at night (fourth night), [9c] . ► Desire to urinate every ten minutes, with pains before and after urinating; urine lemon-yellow and very scanty (repeated after second and third doses), [28] . ► Constant great desire to urinate, with violent tickling in the urethra; the urine flowed almost involuntarily, and I was unable to entirely evacuate it; the urine was orange-yellow, and had a strong odor (second day), [1] . ► Urging to urinate in the evening, [9h] . [1590.] ► Urging to urinate, almost ineffectual, after dinner, [1] . ► Urging to urinate, but inability to do so, with constant bearing-down feeling (after several days), [36] . ► Frequent urging to urinate, [20] . ► Frequent micturition (third day), [9e] ; at night (after nine days), [1] . ► Frequent micturition at night, with interrupted discharge, and subsequent dribbling, [9g] . ► Urinating twice at night, [9h] . ► Increased micturition, twice at night, and in the morning and forenoon; next night, three times, [9h] . ► Micturition four times in two hours (fourteenth days), [29] . ► Passed urine every moment, of an ammoniacal odor (fifth day), [26] . ► Involuntary micturition at night, while dreaming that I was standing at the urinal, [10b] . Pain in back before urinating; ceases after flow; slow in coming, must strain. Retention. Polyuria during the night. Heavy red sediment. Child cries before urinating (Bor)

Urgent want to urinate, with too frequent emission, with discharge of large quantities of pale urine. Frequent micturition by night, with scanty and rare discharges by day. Dark urine with diminished discharge. Greasy pellicle on the urine. Involuntary micturition. Discharge of blood from the bladder, painless. Old thickening of bladder with irritable urethra. Foamy urine. Urine deep coloured, with yellow or reddish sediment. Clear, transparent urine, having a heavy, red, crystallised sediment in the bottom of the chamber. In typhus fever, where the patient is in a very low state, and cannot retain the urine, we may see this sediment on the sheets; also in colic of babies, with much sediment of this kind on the diaper. A very severe pain is felt in the back every time before urinating; causing patient to cry out; retention of urine; patients will get into position to urinate, but wait a great while before the water comes, accompanied by the characteristic pain in the back, which ceases when the urine flows; children often cry out with pain before urinating. Turbid, milky urine, with an offensive purulent sediment; dull pressure in region of bladder and abdomen; disposition to calculi; cystitis. Hæmaturia from gravel or chronic catarrh. Renal calculus and gravel. Emission of blood instead of water, sometimes with paralysis of the legs, and constipation. Incontinence of urine. Smarting when urinating. Itching in urethra during and after emission of urine. Shooting pinchings and incisive pains in the bladder and urethra. Stitches in the bladder. Stitches in the neck of the bladder and in the anus at the same time. Burning in urethra and glans. Urine burning hot, like molten lead.

Aching in kidney < before and > after urinating. θ Diabetes mellitus. Thirst, drinking daily about twenty-two tumblerfuls of water ; flow of urine largely increased and of a pale, watery color. θ Diabetes insipidus. After catching cold, violent colic ; sensation as if he was bound up and would burst ; ineffectual belching and retching ; pain concentrated on right side near hip, not extending beyond median line ; painful spot extremely sensitive to touch, rest of abdomen not painful to pressure ; heavy sensation in bladder, burning on urination ; gurgling in abdomen and noise as if small bladders of air were bursting, followed by much relief and finally copious, moderately thin stool ; six days afterwards, discharge of a porous stone as large as half bean, with much sand and sediment. θ Renal colic. Stiffness in renal regions, especially on right side ; worried by noise or interruption in business ; brings up wind after eating, mentally depressed and physically weak till it comes up ; passes small quantities of fine red sand. θ Gravel. Periodical discharge of gravel and small calculi ; pain in l. kidney and ureter. Frequently compelled to rise at night to urinate ; on urinating, cutting pains in glans penis and abdomen ; urine turbid, loamy, depositing a thick, mucous sediment, occasionally bloody ; when evacuating bowels, must press very hard although stool is not hard ; burning in palms of hands and soles of feet. θ Gravel. Renal colic, particularly in right ureter to bladder ; red sand in urine. Vesical calculi, small, round and rough, with hæmaturia. After taking cold, frequent desire to urinate ; tenesmus of neck of bladder ; dull pain in hypogastrium and loins ; brick dust sediment in urine. θ Acute cystitis. Gums ulcerate, teeth feel loose and ache ; pain in bowels after eating, moving about as from flatus ; stool difficult to pass, with much flatus ; urine very hot, formerly sediment, but since so hot, none ; pain in small of back when standing. θ Cystitis. Turbid, milky urine, with offensive purulent sediment ; dull pressing in region of bladder and abdomen, disposition to calculi. θ Cystitis. Bearing down over bladder, frequent desire to urinate ; pains < lying down, especially at night ; > from horseback riding. Feeling of heaviness in bladder ; burning during micturition. Dull, pressing pain in region of bladder and abdomen. Stitches : in bladder ; in neck of bladder. Frequent hæmaturia ; daily deposit of large clots of blood in urine ; obstinate constipation ; almost total paralysis of feet. Hæmaturia : left kidney affected ; pain in back before urinating ; sediment of red sand ; from gravel or chronic catarrh ; discharge painless. No urine secreted. Retention of urine, violent pain in back, urine flowing in fits and starts. Urine scanty, with red sediment. Urging to urinate : must wait long before it will pass, or inability, with constant bearing down ; supports abdomen with hands. In children urging to pass water, with impossibility to pass it ; cry impatiently and grasp abdomen ; red sand in diaper, or urine may be pale and clear. Pressing in perineum near anus, during and after urinating. θ Enlarged prostate. Frequent desire to urinate, with discharge of large quantities of pale urine. Frequent micturition during night, scanty and infrequent discharges through day. Involuntary micturition. Urine of strong, pungent odor, dribbling away from bladder continually during each afternoon and evening, commencing at 4 P. M. θ Incontinence of urine. Long lasting incontinence of urine resulting from fright during coition. Strangury, urine scanty, dark red or albuminous. Urine : pale, especially during night ; red, burning ; very hot ; foamy ; high colored, turbid ; dark and turbid ; with yellow or reddish deposit of sand ; contains red crystals, as if mingled with brick dust ; turbid, thick, milky, depositing a thick, purulent sediment of a most nauseating smell ; greasy pellicle on surface. Itching in urethra during and after micturition. During urination : soreness or burning in urethra and glans ; jammed feeling in perineum ; cutting pain in abdomen. After urination : crawling, burning in urethra and bladder ; jerking, cutting in urethra.

back.text: NECK AND BACK. ► Neck. ► Involuntary stretching of the neck, now forward, now backward, [1] . ► Involuntary at one time stretching of the neck, at another contraction of the cervical muscles, [1] . ► *Stiffness of the neck , [1] . ► Stiffness of the neck, with confusion of the head (after five days), [1] . ► Stiffness of the nape of the neck (third day), [9c] . [1950.] ► Painful stiffness of the left side of the neck, [4] . ► A kind of paralysis of the cervical muscles; the head constantly sinks forward as if it would fall down, with a dizzy sensation, for six hours; though without inclination to lie down, [1] . ► On stooping, the nape of the neck seems too short, [1] . ► Pain in the nape of the neck (second day), [9c] . ► Pain in the nape of the neck, on bending the head backward, [1] . ► *Tension in the cervical muscles , [1] . ► *Tensive pain in the nape of the neck and occiput , while writing, [9h] . ► *Tensive pain and stiffness in the nape of the neck , and in the shoulders, while walking in the open air, [9d] . ► Spasmodic constriction in the nape of the neck, immediately after dinner (third day), [14] . ► Drawing pinching griping extending up both sides of the neck, [5] . [1960.] ► Drawing pain in the left cervical muscles, [1] . ► Drawing pain in the outer cervical muscles, extending to the shoulders and elbows, [1] . ► Pressure in a small spot in the nape of the neck , [2] . ► Violent pressure in the nape of the neck for many days, [1] . ► Tensive pressure behind and at both sides of the neck, [2] . ► Pressive pain on the outer side of the neck towards the nape, [9] . ► Pain as from a sprain in the nape of the neck (thirteenth day), [30] . ► Pain as from a sprain in the nape of the neck, with sensitiveness of the part to touch (thirty-second day), [30] . ► Jerking pain extending up the right cervical muscles, [5] . ► Back. ► Curvature of the spine, in a child two years of age, lasting several weeks, [1] . [1970.] ► Stiffness extending from the scapula down the back, [5] . ► Stiffness and inflexibility in the back and small of the back, after some exertion, as horseback riding, walking, and stooping; he is able to become erect only slowly and with great difficulty, [1] . ► Pain in the back extending to the shoulders and in the small of the back, [3] . ► Pain in the back while standing, [9f] . ► Pain as from weariness in the back, when writing (third day), [9c] . ► Burning in the back, [1] . ► Tension on the back and hips at noon (third day), [9c] . ► Rheumatic tension in the back and right side of the chest, aggravated by inspiration, [2] . ► Sticking-tensive pains deep in the back, [9d] . ► Pinching in the back, [1] . [1980.] ► Pinching and pressive pain in the right side of the back, [1] . ► Several daily attacks, lasting half an hour, consisting first of griping and squeezing in the back, then extending into the side like a sticking; therewith it became black before her eyes, and she was immediately obliged to lie down wherever she might be, [1] . ► Drawing pain in the back, for several hours (fourth day), [1] . ► Painful drawing in the back, every evening, [9d] . ► Drawing pain in the back, while sitting, [1] . ► Violently pressive pains in the back, sometimes over its whole extent, sometimes in one place, as though one's fist were pressed against the lower vertebræ, when it was accompanied by a similar pressure on the lower extremity of the sternum, so that I was obliged to hold the breath; while sitting and writing, in the morning (second day), [10c] . ► Pain as from a sprain in the left side of the back, extending into the left hypochondrium, [1] . ► Sticking in the back , extending to the small of the back, while sitting, [1] . ► Sticking pain in the back, extending to the right scapula, [1] . ► Dull sticking pain on the right side of the back, especially noticed on deep inspiration; lasting several hours, in the afternoon, while walking (fourteenth day), [11] . [1990.] ► Stitches in the left side of the back, on breathing, [1] . ► Fine stitches in the middle of the back, [1] . ► Cramplike stitches by paroxysms in the middle of the back, making motion impossible for several minutes, [1] . ► Tearing near the right side of the spine, [2] . ► The first dorsal and lumbar vertebræ are painful on touch and motion (sixth day), [27] . ► Constant throbbing in the back, [1] . ► Dorsal. ► Involuntary approximation of the scapulæ backward at one time, at another contraction of the pectoral muscles forward, [4] . ► Rheumatic pain in the left scapula, so that he is unable to raise the arm to the head, [1] . ►► *Burning as from glowing coals between the scapulæ , [1] . ► Tension in the small of the back, as from a hard substance (fourth day), [9i] . [2000.] ► Pressive tension in the left scapula, as from a drawing plaster, [2] . ► Pressive tensive pain in the loins, small of the back, and both hips while walking and standing (fourth day), [9i] . ► Pain in the small of the back, as if constricted, while sitting (second day), [9i] . ► Short aching pain in right scapula (after second dose, second day), [39] . ► Drawing in the back between the scapulæ (after eleven days), [1] . ► Drawing between the scapulæ, in the evening, [1] . ► Drawing in and near the right scapula, in the evening (after ten days), [1] . ► Drawing pain between the scapulæ, [20] . ► Twitching in the left scapula (after several days), [22a] . ► Pressure in the back beneath the shoulder-blades (fifth day), [1] . [2010.] ► First pressure, then burning on the right scapula, [2] . ► Pains beneath the right scapula, which continue as a pressure, soon after a dose, soon followed by movings in the abdomen, with desire for stool (soon), [19] . ► Sticking pain posteriorly in the right scapular region, corresponding to the sticking in the forepart of the chest (thirty-first day), [30] . ► Sticking pains beneath the right scapula, which continued to become worse, and extended to the nape of the neck and head, [20] . ► Stitches between the scapulæ, [1] . ► Stitches beneath the left scapula, [19] . ► Frequent stitches, as with a sharp knife, near the inner margin of the scapulæ, that take away the breath (thirtieth day), [29] . ► Tearing near the spine, below the scapulæ, [2] . ► Bubbling beneath the left scapula, [2] . ► Lumbar. ► Large swelling in the lumbar muscles, very painful on moving the body (removed by Silicea), [1] . [2020.] ► Stiffness in the small of the back, [1] . ► *Pain in the small of the back (sixth day), [27] . ► Pain in the small of the back, extending into the feet, [1] . ► Pain in the small of the back, while lying upon it, with great weakness (third day), [3] . ► Pains in the small of the back, constant, but especially violent when stooping and rising again, [9a] . ► Pain in the small of the back , so violent that it draws the chest together, with pressure in the stomach and constriction in the abdomen (after third day), [1] . ► Pain as if the flesh were loosened in the lower portion of the back, [1] . ► Pain in the small of the back, as if it would break in two, with hard stool and colic, as if the intestines would burst (after forty days), [1] . ► Pain in the small of the back, and stitches in both hips and in the left chest, at night (after four days), [1] . ► *Violent pain in the small of the back, in the morning on rising from bed, so that she was unable to move, during the menses , [1] . [2030.] ► Violent pain in the small of the back; while sitting he cannot sit up straight, but must bend over (after five days), [1] . ► Drawing pain in the small of the back, lasting seventeen days, [1] . ► Pressure in the back above both hips, [2] . ► Pressure in the region of the right kidney, [1] . ► Pressure in the region of the left kidney, [2] . ► Sticking pain in the region of the kidneys, especially on pressure (eighth day), [28] . ► Pressive pain in the small of the back (after four days), [1] . ► Stitches in the small of the back. ► Stitches in the region of the left kidney, [2] . ► Repeated stitches in the back, above the region of the right kidney, [2] . [2040.] ► Intolerable crawling stitches in the lower portion of the back and other parts, [1] . ► Tearing transversely across the small of the back, while sitting erect, [1] . ► Tearing in the region of the right kidney, [2] . ► Bruised pain in the small of the back, while busy in the garden (fifth day), [11] . ► Gurgling somewhat to the left of the small of the back, extending across it, [2] .
Burning between scapulæ as of hot coals. Pain in small of back

Traction and contraction from the nape of the neck to the occiput. Rigidity of the nape of the neck, sometimes caused by lifting a weight. Maculæ hepaticæ in the nape of the neck. Tetters on nape of neck and under armpits. Furunculi under armpits. Stiffness, swelling, and induration of one side of neck. Painful stiffness of l. side of neck. Burning as of red-hot coals between scapulæ. Swelling of glands of neck and of the shoulder, with shooting pain. Weakness and paralysis of muscles of neck. Painful eruption on neck. Large clusters of red pimples around neck, with violent itching. Soreness of the neck. Goître. Violent sacral pains, which do not permit sitting upright. Pains in the back and loins, esp. when moving, stooping, and lifting anything, often accompanied by constrictive pains in abdomen. Shootings in loins on rising up after stooping. Drawing, tearing, and shooting pains in back and loins, with difficult respiration, chiefly when seated, and also at night. Pain in back and r. side, from congestion of the liver. Stitches in region of kidneys, from pressure; extending into rectum. Distortion of the spine.

One side of neck stiff and swollen. Stiffness of left side of neck, head drawn to left side. θ Torticollis. Tensive pain and stiffness in nape of neck and shoulders. Pressure in a small spot in nape of neck. Darting in right cervical muscles from below upward. Sensation in back of neck as if cords were breaking. Carotid aneurism. Bronchocele on right side, tense, smooth, shining appearance, with feeling of constriction in tumor, as if held in some unyielding envelope, while not very large. After catching cold, swelling on neck, followed by suppuration, thereupon formation of callous, fistulous openings, from which oozed a serous discharge. Large clusters of red pimples around neck, with violent itching. Swelling of cervical glands. Burning as from hot coals between scapulæ, < in Summer. Rising of warmth along spine. Drawing and aching between scapulæ. Sticking pain in back, extending to right scapula. Drawing sticking pain in back. Throbbing and pulsating in back ; chilliness. Severe backache > by passing urine. Pain in back and right side, from congestion of liver. Violent pain in small of back in morning on rising from bed, so that she was unable to move, during menses. Pain in small of back, while lying on back, with great weariness, going down to feet ; violent while sitting, not allowing to straighten one's self. Stitches in back towards small of back, when sitting. Pain in small of back as if it would break ; with hard stool and colic as if intestines would burst. Pain in small of back and stitches in both hips and in left chest at night. Pain and stiffness in small of back (at night). Stitches in small of back, especially when rising from stooping. Pain in small of back, extending into thighs. Pain in sacral region, < rising from a seat. Sensation as if flesh was loose on lower part of back. Tearing in sacrum, kidneys and back, especially near spine. Lumbago if Bryonia has not sufficiently relieved and pain is < from slightest motion.

extremities.text: EXTREMITIES IN GENERAL. ► Affected in all the limbs , [1] . ► Unsteadiness of all the limbs as if intoxicated (first day), [19] . ► Stiffness in all the joints , [1] . ► Stiffness in the arms and legs, with insensibility and numbness; he is hardly able to walk without falling; also he is unable to feed himself because he cannot use his hands , [1] . [This symptom occurred in an old man, after the administration of a low dilution of Silicea, for an inveterate tetter. Hahnemann by an oversight put it in Lycopodium. Gross, Archiv. Fur Hom., vol. xx, part i, p. 79. Dr. Hering has kindly called the attention of the Editor to this note by Dr. Gross. Symptom 2048 of Lycopodium must, therefore, be erased. -T. F. A.] ► Trembling of the limbs (after half an hour), [1] . [2050.] ► Drawing trembling in all the limbs, [1] . ► Spasmodic contraction and extension of the limbs, almost without pain, [1] . ► Starting up and jerking in the limbs, with uneasy sleep, [1] . ► The movements of the limbs were almost as in chorea (fifth day), [26] . ► Relaxation and weariness of the limbs, in the morning on waking, disappearing after rising, [1] . ► Weariness of the limbs, especially on ascending steps, [1] . ► Weariness of the limbs, with dryness of the throat, [3] . ► Great weariness in the arms and feet (third and eighth days), [29] . ► Great weariness and prostration in the limbs (sixth day), [30] . ► Weakness and prostration in the hands and feet (sixth day), [27] . [2060.] ► Great weakness of the limbs (first day), [22] . ► Great weakness of all the limbs (nineteenth day), [29] . ► Great weakness of the arms and legs, while walking about (first day), [9c] . ► Great weakness and heaviness in the limbs (seventh day), [27] . ► Great weakness and weariness in the arms and feet (twenty-eighth day), [31] . ► The limbs feel asleep at night (after six days), [1] . ► The fingers and toes fall asleep (twenty-sixth day), [30] . ► Heaviness in the limbs, while walking in the open air, [1] . ► Heaviness of the feet and arms (tenth day), [30] . ► Heaviness of the arms, and especially of the feet, so that I could not play the piano (fifth day), [29] . [2070.] ► Great heaviness of the limbs, previous to menstruation, [1] . ► Pains in the limbs and shoulders (instead of in the chest), (second morning), [9d] . ► Joints painful on motion (sixth day), [27] . ► Drawing tension in the wrists and ankles, in the morning in bed, [2] . ► Drawing in the limbs (fifth day), [16a] . ► Drawing in the limbs, every other afternoon, and also across the face. [1] . ► Drawing in the limbs from above downward, during rest, better on motion, [1] . ► Drawing in the left hand and ankle, in the morning. ► Drawing and stretching in all the limbs, [1] . ► Drawing pains in the second joints of left index and middle fingers, which in a few minutes shifted to the left knee-joint, at 7 P.M. (thirteenth day), [31] . [2080.] ► Intermitting cramplike drawing in the knee, forearms, hands, and fingers, [1] . ► Pressive drawing in all the joints, especially the knees, [1] . ► For four days the child was unwilling to take hold of anything, dreading the tearing pains in the fingers; every evening there were drawing pains in the wrists and fingers of the left hand, and also in the left knee; lasting one or two seconds (fourteenth to seventeenth days), [31] . ► Sticking pain in the last joint of the right index finger, and then suddenly in the left malleolus, in the afternoon (ninth day), [31] . ► Stitches and tearings now in the left, now in the right shoulder, now suddenly into the right knee and right wrist, in the morning (twenty-seventh day), [28] . ► Tearring in the limbs in the morning; after a restless night full of dreams (second day), [19a] . ► Tearing here and there in the limbs (fourth day), [34c] . ► Tearing in various joints, especially the finger-joints (thirty-third day), [31c] . ► Tearing in the left knee-joint and right wrist (thirtieth day), [29] . ► Tearing pains here and there in the extremities (twelfth day), [34d] . [2090.] ► All the limbs are painful to touch, [1] . ► Bruised and heavy sensation in all the limbs, at 4 A.M. (twenty-second day), [29] . ► Crawling and falling asleep in the arms, hands, and feet (fourth day), [9c] . >>>>> Copyright © Médi-T ® 2000 Lyc.

Numbness, also drawing and tearing in limbs, especially while at rest or at night. Heaviness of arms. Tearing in shoulder and elbow joints. One foot hot, the other cold. Chronic gout, with chalky deposits in joints. Profuse sweat of the feet. Pain in heel on treading as from a pebble. Painful callosities on soles; toes and fingers contracted. Sciatica, worse right side. Cannot lie on painful side. Hands and feet numb. Right foot hot, left cold. Cramps in calves and toes at night in bed. Limbs go to sleep. Twitching and jerking

Axillary glands swollen ; fetid sweat in axillæ. Boils in and about axillæ ; scurfy, itching, moist herpetic eruption ; pus continues to discharge from boils for an unusually long time, they no sooner heal than fresh ones appear. Rheumatic tension in right shoulder joint. Tearing pains : in shoulder and elbow joints during rest, not in motion ; from neck to elbow, also in whole arm ; in hands, only while in bed. Pain as from bruises in scapulæ, shoulders and upper arms, < when at rest. Twitching in arms and shoulders. Arms and fingers go to sleep easily ; numbness of hands. Pain in bones of arms at night. Weakness of arms when at work, and conversely they feel powerless, yet he can work. Great dryness of hands, especially of palms. Drawing pain in inner surface of upper arms ; extending over elbows along forearms and wrists. Pain as from a sprain in right wrist joint. Inflammatory redness in all finger joints. Finger joints much distorted and filled with chalk deposits ; profuse, icy cold sweat of affected hands and fingers to extent of several drops a minute, and this in hottest day of July. θ Chronic rheumatic gout. Small boils on hands. Inflammation extending over whole hand ; bluish red swelling ; bluish blisters filled with red or yellow fluid. θ Panaritium. θ Chilblains. Hands constantly hot, which is very troublesome to her. Hands feel numb, dull tingling as if they had been asleep ; sensation of heaviness and feeling of enlargement of hands ; almost everything, even hot things, feel cold to touch ; when writing or driving, the pen or reins drop from hands unnoticed ; no loss of motor power. θ Anesthesia. Warts on fingers, hands and arms. Great dryness of skin of hands. Itching pimples on hands. White scaly tetter on back of hand and fingers. Psoriasis palmaris. Stiffness of fingers from arthritic nodosities. Itching pimples between fingers. Felons with many constitutional symptoms ; panaritium, with gastric affections. Hands swollen and hard ; fingers swollen stiff and extended ; back of hand dark red and burning hot, palm of hand greyish yellow, irregularly swollen, hard and covered with small ulcers ; large, painful, hard, hot swelling between index and middle fingers, stitches like a thorn on touch ; face pale, greyish yellow ; expression of eyes dull ; somnolent ; about 1 or 2 P. M., coldness of feet extending over ankles, as if standing in cold water, followed by chilliness up legs, extending into back ; heaviness and confusion of head, with vertigo and pressing stitching pain in forehead, extending over whole head, particularly in vertex and occiput, with constant roaring in ears ; in nape of neck and shoulders frequent tearing, pressing pains, with oppression and shortness of breath, particularly when lying ; dry cough ; in morning, yellow expectoration, in which there are often small particles like rice, or lumps as large as a pea, pearly in color. θ Rheumatism. Boils on nates. Suppurative stage, when wounds are very irritable ; burning pains. θ Hip disease. Coxalgia, with violent jerks of limbs ; child awakens cross, or with a scream. Pains in left hip joint on motion. Pains as from a sprain in hip. Rheumatic tension in left hip. Frequent jerking of lower limbs, mostly with a groan, awake or slumbering. Neuralgia of extremities. Sciatica : chronic cases ; burning and stinging pains, with complete intermissions ; stiffness and weakness of affected limbs ; < by rest and slightly > by motion ; painful muscular twitchings. Every four days : pain in leg from hip to foot, causing limping. Limbs go to sleep easily. Tearing in middle of right thigh. Feeling of soreness on inner surface of left thigh, with some biting itching, extending to genitals. Smarting pain, and a feeling as if rubbed sore, in skin of thigh, after walking. Several brown spots on inner surface of thighs, close to scrotum, extending from inguinal canal to perineum ; next day spots inflamed, fiery red, swollen, with violent burning pain, especially when touched and walking. Tightness during night in old ulcers of lower parts of thighs. Knee : swollen and stiff ; swollen with sweating ; white swelling ; swelling with perspiration. Stiffness in hollows of knees, as if from a long walk, in morning on rising. On sitting down feels very stiff, particularly in knee joints ; great tremor on standing a while ; difficulty in passing water, has to wait a long time before urine flows ; general symptoms < about 3 P. M. θ Chronic rheumatism. Severe drawing pain in front of legs, from knee down to instep, attack coming on every night when she became warm in bed ; sensation of great heat in affected parts ; restlessness preventing sleep ; similar pain in forehead and occiput ; > during day ; probably caused by living in a damp house. θ Intermittent rheumatic pains. Tearing pains ; swelling and heat in knees and ankles, with swelling of feet and tearing pain in left heel ; stiffness in knees and weakness of affected limbs ; < at night ; chilliness alternating with heat ; tongue furrowed ; sweet taste ; no thirst ; high colored urine ; stitching in right hip ; pains < from motion. θ Rheumatism. Pain as from contraction in calves when walking (cramp), or at night ; cramp in toes. Oozing of water from sore places in œdematous legs. Old ulcers on legs, with nightly tearing, burning and itching. Varicose veins on legs. Herpes on tibia. After injury to ankle, half year ago, slight wound of skin near inner malleolus, followed by ulceration, gradually extending in depth and circumference until whole ankle became affected ; hard callous edges ; offensive, impure, ichorous discharge ; severe burning pains < at night in bed. Feet feel as if dead or asleep. One foot hot, the other cold, or cold sweaty feet. Feet habitually cold ; cold sweat makes them sore. Profuse, fetid foot sweat ; burning of soles ; feet sore. Œdema of feet ; œdema rises until ascites forms. Swelling of left foot, with stitches in toes on stepping. Capillary network on dorsum of foot. Tearing pain through right instep at 8 P. M., usually lasts till midnight. Swelling of soles ; they pain when walking. Fissures on heels, with oozing of water from sore places. Cramp in toes. Stitches : in big toe of right foot (in evening) ; in corns, with sore feeling. Worse on beginning to walk (stiffness) ; > continuing to walk, child wants to be carried. Since birth, soreness between thighs, so that he never yet has attempted to walk, although four years old ; scrofulous in highest degree ; never had least desire to drink ; between 3 and 4 P. M., irritability of whole nervous system, with crying spells on account of pain in left ankle, where bones were softened and discharging a saffron yellow water, with tendency to suppuration ; face covered with freckles ; everything tasted salty to him. θ Rachitis. Tearing in left foot, followed by swelling, pain then extending to thigh and finally into right leg ; sleep disturbed ; later swelling of left leg, then of right ; skin of legs feels hard, although swelling is elastic and does not pit upon pressure ; no redness ; gradually swelling extended up to knees ; severe tensive pains in tendons on motion ; severe biting pains in legs unless warmly covered ; burning in glans penis on urination, lasting several days, then disappearing and reappearing regularly every month ; peculiar sensation extending from right shoulder down to elbow joint, as if arm was dead and without sensation. θ Rheumatism. Numbness of limbs, sensation as if circulation ceased. Drawing, tearing in limbs at night, < during rest and on alternate days ; muscles and joints rigid, painful with numbness ; finger joints inflamed ; also with arthritic nodes ; swelling of dorsa of feet ; rheumatism ; < in wet weather ; > in warmth. Painful stiffness of muscles and numb sensation in joints. Stiffness in all joints. Cracking of joints when stretched. Joint feels as if encircled by band, or ring. Pain in right inner ankle, which spreads over foot and up to knee and is felt in left leg as in right ; ankles and knees stiff, twitching pain on motion ; knees weak ; pain in chest ; thirst every half hour for cold water ; skin hot ; pulse 90 ; knees and inner ankles swollen and tender to touch ; elbows and shoulders stiff ; shooting downward in calves from knees to ankles, first right then left θ Rheumatism. Pain in paroxysms, commencing in right shoulder and arm, extending down right side of trunk to hip, shoots across to l. hip and down leg ; < on motion ; hands and feet generally cold. θ Rheumatism. Erysipelatous inflammation of a number of ulcers on left leg ; also on right leg and forearm. Flat, herpetic looking ulcers on foot ; on making slightest misstep, severe pain in ankle ; constant tensive pain in leg ; leg bluish red, not hot to touch. Fissures on hands ; also on heels. Alternation of heat and cold in rheumatism, or gouty pains in limbs.

sleep.text: SLEEP AND DREAMS. ► Sleepiness. ► *Yawning (sixth day), [33] ; (eighth day), [32a] ; (twenty-sixth day), [31] . [2730.] ► Yawning, sleepiness, falling asleep immediately after eating (third day), [9c] . ► Yawning, with a feeling of emptiness after breakfast (second day), [9i] . ► Yawning and chilliness throughout the day (sixth day), [9c] . ► *Much yawning (after seven days), [1] ; after dinner and supper, [9d] . ► *Frequent yawning (seventh day), [24] ; (twenty-third day), [29] ; all day, [9d] ; in forenoon (twelfth day), [30] . ► Frequent yawning and stretching in the morning (third day), [28] . ► Frequent yawning, with pressure and tension in both temples (second day), [9c] . ► Frequent yawning, with sore pain at the root of the tongue (fourth and fifth days), [34c] . ► Frequent and repeated yawning, with mucus in the throat (first day), [9c] . ► Constant yawning all day (first day), [17a] . [2740.] ► Constant yawning, sleepiness, and weariness of the feet (third day), [32a] . ► Constant and excessive yawning, with lachrymation and heaviness of the head (second morning), [9i] . ► Persistent, repeated, excessive yawning (in the evening after reading), [9g] . ► Incessant yawning (second and tenth days), [33] . ► Incomplete yawning; she is frequently obliged to open the mouth wide, and even then cannot yawn sufficiently, [1] . ► The child is unable to yawn; it cries because it cannot yawn completely, [1] . ► Sleepiness (second and third days), [33] ; (sixth day), [24] . ► Sleepiness during the day; he falls asleep while sitting, [1] . ► Sleepiness all day on attempting to read and with every other work; weak and heavy in the limbs; apathetic (second day), [9c] . ► Sleepiness in the afternoon, [1] . [2750.] ► Sleepiness in the forenoon, with pressure upon the eyes, frequent yawning, and internal chilliness, [2] . ► Sleepiness in the morning (fifth day), [28] . ► Sleepiness an hour after eating (fourth day), [9i] . ► Sleepiness during a horseback ride of some hours, so that he could hardly keep awake on the horse, at 2 P.M. (seventh and twenty-third days), [29] . ► Even while walking she cannot keep awake, [1] . ► Unusual sleepiness and sound sleep in the evening (sixth day), [30] . ► Unusual sleepiness, with very speedy falling asleep in the evening (first day), [30] . ► Unusual sleepiness; could not keep awake in spite of every exertion; went to bed at 8.30, and passed the night in anxious dreams (seventeenth night), [29] . ► Great sleepiness (sixteenth day), [29] ; in evening (eleventh day), [30] ; early, [2] . ► Great sleepiness in the evening so that he was unable to read in bed at 10 o'clock as usual (second day), [29] . [2760.] ► Great sleepiness and weariness during the day, [20] . ► Great sleepiness soon after waking (thirty-sixth day), [31] . ► Great sleepiness and restless sleep (seventh day), [33] . ► Irresistible sleepiness at 1 P.M.
